type.instructions: Classify the supplied issue from its stripped text and retrieved duplicate candidates only. Choose the single best-fitting issue type, or 'unclear' when the supplied evidence is insufficient.

criteria.bug: Incorrect behavior or a silent failure
criteria.requirements: Requirements work (add or revise a requirement)
criteria.security: Path traversal, injection, or unsafe paths
criteria.unclear: The supplied evidence is insufficient to classify the type

subsystem.instructions: Choose the owning subsystem of the supplied issue from the supplied closed set only, or 'unknown' when no supplied subsystem fits. Never invent a subsystem.

criteria.load-files: Load File emission: composers, serializers, emitter
criteria.cli: CLI argument parsing and domain modules
criteria.archive: ZIP archive creation and path handling
criteria.unknown: No supplied subsystem fits the issue

priority.instructions: Choose P0 (blocker/production broken/data loss), P1 (high: security, correctness, coverage holes on critical code), P2 (medium: this iteration), P3 (low: nice to have) using the repository priority definitions supplied, or 'insufficient-evidence' when the supplied text cannot support a priority.

criteria.P0: Blocker: production broken or data loss
criteria.P1: High: security, correctness, or coverage holes on critical code
criteria.insufficient-evidence: The supplied text cannot support a priority

missing_info.instructions: Judge whether essential reproduction or specification information is missing from the supplied issue text. Return the probability that this judgment is NOUL (information is NOT missing).

criteria.true: Essential reproduction or specification information is present in the issue text
criteria.false: Essential reproduction or specification information is missing from the issue text

duplicate_question.instructions: For the supplied retrieved candidate issue only, judge its relationship to the triaged issue: 'duplicate' (same underlying defect/request), 'related' (adjacent area, different defect), 'unrelated', or 'uncertain'.

criteria.uncertain: The supplied evidence is insufficient to decide

req_question.instructions: Judge whether the supplied issue materially concerns the supplied requirement (it changes, violates, or clarifies the requirement's behavior). Return the probability that this judgment is NOUL (the issue does NOT materially concern this requirement).

criteria.true: The issue does NOT materially concern the requirement
criteria.false: The issue DOES materially concern the requirement
